correctness.rationale: The free norm gives the two-sided estimate directly. For sharpness, Lemma 3.1 supplies q with endpoint values 0 and 1 and range in [0,1]; p=q-1 is again a lattice homomorphism into [-1,1], and |q(x)|+|p(x)|=1 for every x. Thus (q,p) is admissible and evaluates the canonical strong unit to 1 at both entries, forcing norm 2. The upper estimate forces equality, and delta_m gives norm one for the forward restriction map.
